objective: Test whether tighter GP-amplitude priors can suppress the supported Nordic background without erasing the current model's endemic peaks.
draw_alignment: Use the exact 500 selected_draw_indices in draws-manifest.json to align posterior amplitude/intercept samples with frequency_draws.npy rows.

diagnostics.posterior_summary: weighted median and central 50/95 percent intervals

decision_rule: A candidate is only worth a full refit if it passes both importance-weight diagnostics, lowers the Nordic frequency, and does not lower the endemic-minus-Nordic contrast. This preflight cannot establish held-out count improvement, calibration, or publication eligibility.
